# Experiment E5 of docs/spec/text-component.md, section 8.7: limits.
# Source: the log of the vanilla client. The text of a message has up to 1048576 characters, so a line in this
# fixture replaces the text by its measure: the number of characters, the set of characters that the text holds,
# and whether it holds "END". A measure in angle brackets is a note of the fixture, not game output.
# A leaf is the innermost text. A level repeats its argument with %1$s. The top text ends with %2$s, that holds "END".
# The player is the offline test player Recorder. The vanilla client of the project version joined the vanilla server
# on 127.0.0.1. The server ran in offline mode. The console of the server gave each command.
# Each case has a header line with the id, the line of the command, and the log lines that the case wrote.
# A line that starts with "C " is a line of the client log. A line that starts with "S " is a line of the server log.
# A command with no output line wrote nothing in that log. The text after "[CHAT] " is the plain string that the process makes.
#
